report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency, but current gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.0012, p95 80ms, no dependency timeouts or pool waiters, and an INFO 200 log. Only one ERROR trace (gateway->order, 1933ms) hints at downstream latency, but no order-service evidence exists to bound a cause. Insufficient evidence to name a root cause; hand off for order-service and dependency telemetry.

Downstream dependency metrics for order->postgresql/payment/inventory to test db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, or downstream-latency
